info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Platform Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Platform Operations Management API enables users to initiate and manage operational actions within the IT management framework. This API allows for the streamlined execution of various platform operations, enhancing efficiency and oversight in banking environments. Typical consumers include IT administrators and operations teams who require real-time control and monitoring of platform activities. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure optimal performance and reliability of their operational processes.

post.summary: Create a new operational action in IT management.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new operational action within the IT management platform. It involves specifying the action details in the request body, which will then be processed to register the action in the system.
